hooks.command: file_path="${CODEX_FILE_PATH:-$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH}"; if [[ -n "$file_path" && "$file_path" == *.py ]]; then uv run ruff check --fix "$file_path" && uv run ruff format "$file_path"; fi
file_path="${CODEX_FILE_PATH:-$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH}"; if [[ -n "$file_path" && "$file_path" == *.py ]]; then uv run pytest -x -q; fi
